note: A simulated buyer walk: a local 7B model played four buyers and read this page's text cold, part by part, one buyer at a time (36 readings, about 2.5 hours). It is a model's first-pass audit, not a customer's opinion. Kar checked every gap it raised against the page, and pressed every button on the page by hand (the quote check with each of its suggested changes, growing the published run again, a new attack, and growing twelve problems live). The real gaps are below, each with what was changed. Not changed: lines that only quoted the page back (the footer, the case for the board), and one that was right as it stood (a forgery tried only 10 times applies only to lines that carry a clause number). A first try that asked for all four buyers in one reply was not kept: the model answered "none" to nearly every part, which is no evidence the page is clear.
